purpose: Record the current expert-validation disposition for all CBCs. This queue is not a competing implementation/status authority; CAPABILITY_MATRIX.json remains authoritative. On 2026-08-10 the project owner authorized a temporary governance assumption that all current CBC behavior is expert-validated for project workflow; missing mechanisms and device/institution/regulatory-specific claims remain separately gated.

priority_definition.A: learner-operable mechanism/control already exposed; review first
priority_definition.B: headless/indirect mechanism or incomplete production fault surface; review after Priority A unless needed by a scenario

items.learner_exposure: direct — generic intravascular volume and ECMO RPM are learner-operable
items.device_or_policy_evidence: not required for directional contract; local volume-resuscitation policy must be separate from regression stimuli
review_questions: Are the preconditions a plausible non-chattering teaching baseline?
Are the expected directions for preload, patient flow, MAP, CVP and drainage pressure appropriate?
Is RPM escalation correctly framed as non-definitive/worsening drainage under preload limitation?
Are allowed exceptions and non-claims sufficient to prevent treating the regression stimulus as a treatment threshold?
items.blocking_for_external_training: single-reviewer clinical review complete (project author, practicing ECMO specialist); independent external review by facility ECMO educator required before external-training/go-live; device/institution/regulatory-specific claims remain separately gated

items.device_or_policy_evidence: device/manufacturer gas-path operating evidence desirable before device-specific claims
review_questions: Is complete zero sweep correctly represented as loss of both membrane O2 addition and CO2 removal?
Are nonzero sweep and FdO2 roles kept appropriately separate?
Is the membrane-boundary validation acceptable while coupled-patient venous-state limitations remain disclosed?

review_questions: Is UF gating on CKRT selected + Qb>0 appropriate for the intended simulator workflow?
Are matched-control volume/preload consequences appropriate?
Is stopping UF correctly distinguished from replacing lost volume?
Are the current Qb/net-UF values clearly retained as regression stimuli rather than prescriptions?

Is the PEEP-to-ECMO drainage block adequate until transmural preload exists?
Are re-equilibration and recruitment/derecruitment limitations clearly separated?
